bands.title: Cursed
messages: Your umbrella opened indoors and it is still raining outside.
The coin landed on its edge, then rolled under the fridge.
Today has plot armor for the inconveniences.
Your alarm clock went off early, and it was the wrong day.
The elevator closed just as you reached the door.
Your favorite snack is sold out everywhere you look.
The Wi-Fi disconnected right before you clicked submit.
You dropped something, picked it up, and immediately dropped it again.
The one pen you need has mysteriously vanished.
Your shoelace came undone at the worst possible moment.
You finally got comfortable, then remembered an unfinished task.
The game crashed one second before your progress saved.
Your charger works only when held at a very specific angle.
You opened the fridge three times and still found nothing new.
The universe has placed you on its inconvenience subscription plan.

bands.title: Unlucky
messages: The queue you chose has entered a mysterious pause.
Your toast landed butter-side down in a very theatrical way.
A minor inconvenience has sent a calendar invite.
You arrived just in time to see the bus leave.
The video buffered right before the best part.
Your favorite song ended as soon as you got into the mood.
You chose the slowest checkout line with impressive accuracy.
The download reached 99% and decided to think about life.
You forgot why you entered the room.
Your pen ran out of ink during the most important sentence.
The weather changed its mind five minutes after you left.
You finally found the answer, then the question disappeared.
The update started exactly when you needed your computer.
Your snack fell just out of reach.
You got the wrong answer after changing your correct one.
The one thing you need is always in the last place you check.
Your plans survived, but your schedule did not.
The universe gave you a small challenge instead of a reward.

bands.title: Average
messages: The universe has provided an ordinary Tuesday.
Your luck is steady: no fireworks, no falling pianos.
Things are proceeding at a perfectly reasonable pace.
You found what you were looking for after a little searching.
Nothing extraordinary happened, and that is perfectly fine.
Your day is running on standard settings.
The coin landed on heads. Nobody was surprised.
Your plans worked out approximately as expected.
You got a decent seat, but not the best one.
The weather is doing exactly what the forecast predicted.
Your internet is working, and that is today's small victory.
You remembered most of what you needed to do.
The universe has neither helped nor inconvenienced you today.
Your luck is as dependable as a regular weekday.

bands.title: Fortunate
messages: You found the good seat and the charger nearby.
A small win has entered the chat.
The timing worked out better than expected.
Your favorite snack was still available.
You guessed correctly on the first try.
The bus arrived just as you reached the stop.
You found a little extra time in your schedule.
Your device had exactly enough battery to finish the task.
Someone saved you a seat without being asked.
You remembered something important at the perfect moment.
The download finished just before you needed the file.
Your plans went smoothly with only minor adjustments.

bands.title: Lucky
messages: The last cookie was still available. A fine omen.
Your plans found a green light at just the right moment.
A lucky break is quietly doing its job.
You found money in a pocket you had forgotten about.
The answer you needed appeared right when you searched.
You arrived early without even trying.
Your favorite song played at the perfect moment.
The weather held up exactly when you needed it to.
You picked the right option without overthinking it.
Someone canceled, leaving you with the perfect opportunity.
Your computer restarted without losing any work.
Every little thing seems to be going your way today.
You avoided a problem you did not even know was coming.

bands.title: Extremely Lucky
messages: You picked the shortest line without even trying.
The exact thing you needed appeared at the perfect moment.
The universe has put in a very favorable word for you.
You guessed the answer correctly before seeing the options.
Your plans aligned so perfectly that it felt scripted.
You got the last available seat in the entire room.
The rare item appeared on your first attempt.
You avoided a delay by choosing a completely random route.
Your timing deserves its own highlight reel.
You opened the right page on the first click.
Three separate things went right in a row. Suspicious.
The odds were against you, but apparently nobody told luck.
You received good news when you least expected it.

bands.title: Impossible Luck
messages: You found the missing item in the first place you looked.
Every traffic light turned green; the legends were true.
This score is so lucky it should buy the next round of snacks.
You predicted the outcome correctly before anything happened.
Every random choice you made turned out perfectly.
You found the rarest item on your very first attempt.
The universe temporarily switched to easy mode just for you.
You got every answer right by trusting your instincts.
Your luck stat has exceeded the maximum permitted by reality.
The probability calculator has officially requested a second opinion.
